scripts.preinstall: [ "$NODE_ENV" = 'production' ] && echo '⚠️  NODE_ENV=production — devDependencies will be skipped. Run: unset NODE_ENV' >&2 || true
scripts.dev:open: tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs open
scripts.dev:drive: tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive
scripts.dev:eval: tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --eval
scripts.dev:query: tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --query
scripts.dev:state: tsx scripts/drive-preflight.ts && node scripts/with-source.mjs node scripts/app-dev.mjs drive --state
scripts.build:default-setup: npm run packages:ensure && npm run build -w @app/default-setup
scripts.typecheck:renderer: npm run type-check --workspace @app/renderer && echo '✅ Frontend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:api: cd packages/api && npx tsc -p . --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && echo '✅ Backend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:main: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/main && echo '✅ Electron main type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:preload: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/preload && echo '✅ Preload type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack: npm run packages:ensure && npm run typecheck --workspace @app/default-setup && echo '✅ Default-setup pack type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ears: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/ears && echo '✅ EARS type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/sdk && echo '✅ SDK type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:host: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/host && echo '✅ Host type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ui: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/ui && echo '✅ UI type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run typecheck --workspace @apackdev/cli --workspace @apackdev/testing && echo '✅ CLI + testing type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc -p scripts && tsc -p tests && tsc -p packages/repo-checks && tsc -p packages/publish-checks && echo '✅ Scripts, repo and publish checks, and E2E type check passed'
scripts.api:update: npm run packages:ensure && npm run api:update -w @apackdev/ears -w @apackdev/sdk -w @apackdev/ui -w @apackdev/testing
scripts.test:e2e: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:smoke: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/smoke
scripts.test:headed: npm run packages:ensure && PLAYWRIGHT_VISIBLE=1 node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:explorer: npm run packages:ensure && node scripts/with-source.mjs playwright test --ui
scripts.test:external-pack: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/scripts/test-external-pack.sh
scripts.test:external-pack:contract: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/bounded.ts suite bash tests/scripts/test-external-pack-contract.sh
scripts.test:external-pack:fork: npm run packages:ensure && tsx scripts/bounded.ts scenario tsx tests/scripts/prepare-default-pack-fork.ts
scripts.test:packaged-authoring:author: tsx scripts/bounded.ts scenario bash tests/scripts/test-packaged-authoring-author.sh
